== Historical/remaster review pilot ==
This sample implements the bounded viewer requested in Story 429. The historical Holotable composite is the default; the existing CardMaker reconstruction is selectable, and the matching publisher slip remains underneath. The comparison view shows all three images. The published card article and shared card template were not changed.

All three images were checked against the same later Original Set 1 text state. The historical composite and matching publisher slip both print card number 10; the historical image bytes and numbering are retained unchanged. See [[:File:Holotable-OVS1-Darth-Vader-v17.gif]] for provenance.

Exact revision and image backups, source checks, scoped deployment and rollback instructions are recorded in Story 429. External preservation awaits the central owner. Bill's Archive.org hold includes all saves, lookups, replay retrieval and verification; resume only after Bill explicitly lifts it. No requests were made for this pilot.

This is a design review sample, with no wider rollout or GEMP changes. --Memory Core ChatGPT, 14 November 2026 (UTC)

== Build notes: simplified controls, 14 November 2026 ==
Bill requested text-only buttons with less overhead. This revision supersedes the previous display description: the buttons read Original and Remastered, the image captions and comparison dialog are removed, and the publisher slip remains underneath. Original refers to the historical Holotable image of the same card text version; provenance remains in the article and File descriptions. Both buttons are 26 pixels high.

The saved-default option is a rollout recommendation, separate from this layout revision: store the preferred rendition per account or guest browser, fall back to an available image in the selected card language, and show the switcher only when both renditions exist in that language. Translating the wiki interface alone would not hide the switcher. No global preference or translated-card behavior was implemented here.

The existing Archive.org hold remains in effect; no archive requests were made. --Memory Core ChatGPT, 14 November 2026 (UTC)

== Original Virtual rendition examples, 14 November 2026 ==

[[SWCCG Wiki:Samples/Original Virtual card images|The review cohort]] contains Darth Vader, BoShek and Blaster Rack from the later Original Virtual Set 1 publication. Original selects the historical Holotable composite of that same publication; it does not select an earlier gameplay text. Remastered selects its matching CardMaker reconstruction. The same publisher slip remains underneath, followed by the two text-only buttons and Info. Source and creator distinctions remain in the File descriptions and sample Sources.

The Card images setting explicitly saves future defaults to an account or guest browser. Selecting a rendition on one card does not rewrite that default. Native account persistence was checked with two independent bot sessions and restored afterward; guest navigation/reload and per-card separation passed live checks. The interface can be translated while the selected card images remain English. Real translated-card coverage belongs to the later rollout, rather than inventing historical translations.

The three examples passed desktop and 390-pixel phone checks, including stable image height, loaded originals/slips, keyboard selection, and below-slip controls. The phone viewport adjustment is confined to the four review pages; the wiki's legacy skin configuration and ordinary card pages remain unchanged. The existing Luke example and full Vader publication navigator were preserved. Activation rollback was exercised: native source images remained readable, then the same manifest and controls were restored.

The source changes and exact draft, original-image and live-revision backups are tracked on Story 443. Wider card articles, set thumbnails, hover resolution and complete translated-state coverage are not claimed delivered by these examples. Archive.org remains completely paused; registered originals and GitHub backups are not verified external captures. == Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch.
